title: zazzle invoker source class diagram
description: The C structures the invoker declares: its own copies of the kernel's message, control-message, socket-address and time layouts, so no system headers are needed. Linux and macOS declare them separately with their own field widths; test/sys_mock.h repeats the Linux layout.

types.name: struct zazzle_msghdr
members: iovlen (size_t on Linux, int32_t on macOS)
controllen (size_t on Linux, uint32_t on macOS)

types.name: struct zazzle_cmsghdr
members: len (size_t on Linux, uint32_t on macOS)

types.name: struct zazzle_sockaddr_un
members: family (uint16_t on Linux, uint8_t on macOS)
char path[108] on Linux, path[104] on macOS
